title: French antitrust watchdog orders Meta to resume talks with media groups over publishing fees
title_zh: 法国反垄断监管机构命令 Meta 恢复与媒体集团就出版费用进行谈判
summary: PARIS, July 8 () - France's competition authority on Wednesday ordered Meta Platforms to resume talks with French ‌media groups over payments for publishing content, after the ‌publishers complained following the collapse of previous negotiations.
summary_zh: 巴黎，7 月 8 日 - 法国竞争主管机构周三下令 Meta Platforms 恢复与法国媒体集团就出版内容付费问题进行谈判，此前出版商因之前的谈判破裂而提出抱怨。

title_zh: 加拿大寻求数据中心，大型科技公司加入卡尔加里牛仔节石油狂欢

title: Crypto firms prepare defenses as quantum threat to encryption draws nearer
title_zh: 随着加密的量子威胁越来越近，加密货币公司准备防御
summary: The cryptocurrency industry is starting to prepare for the threat of quantum computing as recent advances fuel concerns that the technology could soon be able to crack the cryptography that protects transactions and digital wallets.
summary_zh: 加密货币行业正在开始为量子计算的威胁做好准备，因为最近的进展引发了人们的担忧，即该技术可能很快就能破解保护交易和数字钱包的密码学。

title: Apple to spend $30 billion in Broadcom chips deal that will see Colorado factory expand
title_zh: 苹果将​​斥资 300 亿美元收购博通芯片交易，科罗拉多州工厂将扩建
summary: Apple plans to spend more than $30 billion as part ‌of a chip-supply agreement reached earlier this ‌week with Broadcom that will also see the chipmaker expand a ​factory in Colorado, the companies said on Wednesday.
summary_zh: 两家公司周三表示，苹果计划斥资超过 300 亿美元，作为本周早些时候与博通达成的芯片供应协议的一部分，该芯片制造商还将扩建科罗拉多州的一家工厂。

title: Big Tech is dodging the chip stocks wipeout: AlphaCheck
title_zh: AlphaCheck：大型科技公司正在躲避芯片股的暴跌
summary: Memory stocks are in a bear market, but the Magnificent Seven are back on the offense — leading the market higher once again.
summary_zh: 内存股正处于熊市，但七巨头重新发起进攻，再次引领市场走高。

title: Apple announces chip deal with Broadcom worth more than $30 billion
title_zh: 苹果宣布与博通达成价值超过 300 亿美元的芯片交易
summary: Apple announced a $30 billion deal with Broadcom.
summary_zh: 苹果宣布与博通达成价值 300 亿美元的交易。

title: US stock futures tumble as Trump says Iran deal is 'over'; oil climbs

title: Apple loses challenges against EU rules to curb Big Tech
title_zh: 苹果在针对欧盟遏制大型科技规则的挑战中败诉
summary: Apple lost its challenge on Wednesday against landmark EU rules that designate its app stores and operating system iOS as gatekeepers subject to obligations ‌aimed at giving rivals more room to compete.
summary_zh: 周三，苹果公司在对具有里程碑意义的欧盟规则的挑战中失败，该规则指定其应用程序商店和操作系统 iOS 为看门人，并遵守旨在为竞争对手提供更多竞争空间的义务。
